blocks.text: SAN ANTONIO, ZAMBALES, Philippines — Police seized seven firearms, a hand grenade, ammunition, and suspected illegal drugs in three separate operations in Zambales on Saturday, Sept. 26. Two search warrant operations in this town led to the recovery of six firearms, a hand grenade, and assorted ammunition from individuals whom police intelligence linked to an alleged robbery group, according to the Philippine National Police (PNP). Police said the firearms and ammunition were secured as evidence as authorities continued to investigate their possible connection to criminal activities.
